playbooks.name: learn-from-session
playbooks.title: make the team better every round

steps.text: **Gather**, in this order · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม
sub: The central queue `~/.claude/superuser/IMPROVEMENTS.md` and `IMPROVEMENTS.md`: rows where "รวมแล้ว" (merged) = `ยัง` (not yet) and "ควรรวมไหม" (should merge?) ≠ `ไม่รวม` (do not merge), sorted by "ครั้ง" (times) high to low, then open the evidence under "ที่มา" (source). For a central-queue row (this column exists only in the central queue) that is merged and has reached its "ตรวจวันที่" (check date), look at the log and fill "ผลหลังรวม" (result after merge). It happened again 2 times → that row comes back as this round's job: make it a checker or roll the fix back.
`.claude/superuser/learn/*.md` of the open projects: the "ควรปรับทีม" (team should change) table (older notes: "ควรปรับ skill"). Merge rows about the same issue into one row and count the times.

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม

steps.text: **Classify**, ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม
sub: **Count the mistake types first.** Tag every row `ไม่ได้เปิด skill` (did not open the skill) · `เปิดแต่ไม่ทำตาม` (opened but did not follow) · `ไม่มีกฎ` (no rule) (definitions in the agent `learning-reviewer`), then count. Mostly `ไม่ได้เปิด` → this round's job is to fix how skills are signalled (`triggers.md` · `hooks/skill-router.json`), not to write more text in the skill.
**A skill that has absorbed 3 merged lessons but mistakes did not drop.** Stop adding text. Propose one of: a checker, a paired example (before → after), or rolling the fix back.

**A repeated mistake** (found 2 or more times · `correction: true` in the log for the same issue): make it a checker, do not write more warnings (`learn-loop/repeated-mistakes-to-checks` if present, otherwise a check script or an item in the pre-send checklist).
**A method that worked, or a skill that says something wrong:** fix the paragraph in SKILL.md (`learn-loop/session-lessons-to-skills` if present).
**A playbook assembled on the spot and reused 2 or more times:** propose it as a permanent playbook per [`playbook-template`](playbook-template.md).
**Fixing an agent or playbook:** fix the matching paragraph · a playbook must still pass `validate-marketplace.mjs`.
**A user rule:** 1 line in `~/.claude/superuser-style.md`, which works from every project.
**Cut:** delete lines a checker already catches, or that duplicate another file.

**A new skill or agent:** only for rows the user has `รับ` (accepted) and that cannot be fixed by changing the existing one · a new agent needs a reason about context, tools, or model, otherwise make it a skill.

steps.text: **Drop one-off events.** Once is not yet a lesson · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม

steps.text: **Every lesson must end as a concrete fix:** a checker · a script · a corrected paragraph. If the existing thing can be fixed, do not create a new one. If a new item contradicts an old one, fix the old one, do not append · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม

steps.text: **Propose to the user.** A table: type · where · old → new · evidence · times · expected · check date. Ask them to answer item by item `รับ` (accept) · `ไม่รับ` (decline) · `ไว้ทีหลัง` (later). Items not yet `รับ` go under "รออนุมัติ" and the files are not edited yet · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม

steps.text: **Fix only items that are `รับ`** (answered, or `ควรรวม` (should merge) in the queue), one paragraph at a time, never rewriting the whole file. A new checker must be run against the original event to show that it **fails before the fix and passes after**, then keep that event as a test case (a self-test or the script's test). Shared things are fixed in plugin `superuser`, then run `node scripts/sync/sync-superuser.mjs` and `validate-marketplace.mjs` (single-plugin install: propose old → new for the user to fix in the SQT-Marketplace repo) · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม fixes · `reviewer` ตัวใหม่ checks against the evidence

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม fixes · `reviewer` ตัวใหม่ checks against the evidence

steps.text: **Close the list.** Move handled notes to `.claude/superuser/learn/done/`, then in `IMPROVEMENTS.md` and the central queue set the "ควรรวมไหม" field to `ควรรวม` or `ไม่รวม (<reason>)` and the "รวมแล้ว" field to `แล้ว <date> (<file>)` (done <date> (<file>)), only for rows where files were really fixed · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม

steps.text: Do one piece at a time. Pass the section 4 criteria, then go to the next piece. Breaks twice → split into sub-steps, do not retry the same way · after 3 rounds → record it as `ติด` and go to other pieces · ใคร: workers per the `ลูกทีมต่อชิ้น` line above, a fresh one per piece · check (ตรวจ): per the `ผู้ตรวจต่อชิ้น` line above
sub: **After getting stuck.** Record in "ค้างอยู่" (pending) what was tried · where the problem probably is · what is needed to go on. Keep the unfinished work separately as a draft, not over pieces that already passed.
**A piece that must wait for a stuck piece.** Record it as `ติด` with reason `รอ <piece>` (waiting for <piece>), without trying.
**All other pieces are done.** Have a fresh agent on a larger model try once more from that note (an answer in the inbox → start from the answer).
**Still stuck.** Keep it in the report with what is needed from the user · the user answers later → a new session reads `CONTEXT.md` and continues from that piece.

**Stuck because it must be the user** (a decision · a check by eye or ear · spending money or tokens · endorsing text an agent wrote on their behalf): add a row to the "รอผู้ใช้" (waiting on the user) table of `CONTEXT.md` and go on to other pieces, without stopping to wait.

who.raw: workers per the `ลูกทีมต่อชิ้น` line above, a fresh one per piece · check (ตรวจ): per the `ผู้ตรวจต่อชิ้น` line above

steps.text: Every time you choose a path on your own, record it in the "การตัดสินใจ" (decisions) table at once, do not bundle it to write at the end · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม

steps.text: If you meet an item that is "รออนุมัติ" (example in the `รออนุมัติที่เจอบ่อย` line above · full list in `autonomy`, section "รออนุมัติ — ทุกสาขา" of `superuser`), prepare it ready to press, never do it yourself; put questions the user must answer under "ค้างอยู่" · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม (approval: the user)
sub: **Messages to outsiders are written as drafts in the outbox.** An email draft, a reply, a review, or a post goes into a file `.claude/superuser/outbound/<date>-<topic>.md` (recipient · channel · ready-to-send text · reason for sending), then move on to the next piece without stopping to wait for a person · drafting needs no approval, actually sending does · the user sends it, or orders it sent later on their behalf · list the outbox item in the "รอผู้ใช้" table of `CONTEXT.md`, 1 row per file.

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม (approval: the user)

steps.text: After finishing each piece, update "ความคืบหน้า" and "รับงานต่อ" (pick up the work), then look in `.claude/superuser/inbox/`, so a user coming back midway sees the latest status · starting a new session mid-job → run the "เสร็จเมื่อ" (done when) checker of the latest `เสร็จ` piece once before the next piece; fail → fix that piece first · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม

steps.text: When the job is finished, check all the step 1 conditions once more, run the learning round, then report once: what is done · what is stuck · how many decisions made on your own · what awaits approval · what is pending · ใคร: หัวหน้าทีม (re-checking the conditions: `reviewer` ตัวใหม่)
sub: End the report with a table `ขั้น | ผล | หลักฐาน` (step | result | evidence), 1 row per condition in step 1 · evidence is a file path · link · check result · summarise as **"ผ่าน X / N"** (passed X of N) counted from the real checker, not from what workers say · an item that needs a human eye does not count as passed, put it in a separate row `ต้องให้คนดู` (needs a person to look) · for items that failed, give the cause in 1 line.

who.raw: หัวหน้าทีม (re-checking the conditions: `reviewer` ตัวใหม่)
